fields.headline: Brew & Bean kitchen
fields.summary: Served 17:00–21:30, Wednesday to Sunday. Everything is cooked to order, so allow a little time. Prices in DKK.

media.alt: Bowl of coconut chicken curry with mint and coriander

details.note: Tell us about allergies when you order — the kitchen adapts most dishes.
